versions.subject: Merge PR #5528 from @MATTANDERS0N - add rules for defense evasion
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
          - '\powershell_ise.exe'
          - '\powershell.exe'
          - '\pwsh.exe'
          - '\reg.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
          - 'powershell_ise.EXE'
          - 'PowerShell.EXE'
          - 'pwsh.dll'
          - 'reg.exe'
selection_action:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'del'
        - 'Remove-Item'
        - 'ri '
selection_reg_path:
    CommandLine|contains: '\shellex\ContextMenuHandlers\EPP'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell_ise.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\reg.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("powershell_ise.EXE", "PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll", "reg.exe") CommandLine IN ("*del*", "*Remove-Item*", "*ri *") CommandLine="*\\shellex\\ContextMenuHandlers\\EPP*"
